fluff.overview: The 292nd League Regulars are a conventional infantry unit attached to the Gryphons, one of two BattleMech regiments in the Silver Hawk Irregulars brigade. The Silver Hawks draw from the planetary defense forces of five coalition provinces near the Lyran border, and the 292nd reflects that scrappy, independent character. Despite the Gryphons' uneven combat record, the 292nd earned recognition by reintroducing anti-aircraft jump infantry after the specialty had been disbanded since the early Succession Wars. Equipped with auto-rifles and man-portable anti-aircraft guns, the platoons provide dedicated point air defense for ground formations that previously lacked any organic counter to low-flying aerospace threats. Backed by their auto-rifles for ground engagements, the 292nd's platoons proved effective enough to inspire similar formations across the former League's successor states.
